ms.report:
1. Outputs Delivered:
・CIP-1694 and Cardano Governance Workshop was conducted on November 30, 2024 as per the schedule published previously in luma event: https://lu.ma/s9u3frc8. The audience was educated about Cardano and its vision for Voltaire age, DReps and how the community can participate in Governance.
・This workshop was featured as a side event organised during India Blockchain Week (IBW) 2024. IBW is India's flagship series of blockchain and Web3 events, conducted over the course of a week. This year, it was held in Bengaluru. 

 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lambdacc/cip1694-cardano-gov-workshop/main/docs/IBW-event-list-screenshot.png
・There was lively participation from the attendees, sharing of views and ideas.

2. Acceptance Criteria Met:
・The workshop was conducted as per the schedule announced, covering all modules.
・Information about the Cardano, Voltaire era, DReps, and community participation in Governance is presented.
・Interactive elements were incorporated to encourage audience engagement by means of interactive online quiz, Group discussion and case studies.
・Opportunities for attendees to ask questions and share views were provided

3. Evidence of Milestone Completion:
・Attendance record. It was requested by the catalyst team to remove any personal information from the attendance sheet while sharing publicly. In order to not protect personal information like name, email/phone number, signature provided by participants, a redacted version of the attendance sheet is shared at this link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dIEGD8KZY2sR-0_WJH_fp5txGMTxwezu/view?usp=sharing

During the two days preceding the workshop, our team reached out to most of the registered participants by telephone to confirm their attendance and address any queries they might have. This was done in response to a significant number of late registrations and email requests to join the workshop, and to open up more slots in case anyone was unable to attend.

ms.report:
Milestone outputs: 
Final closeout report (public link shared below)
Final closeout video (public link shared below)
Acceptance Criteria
・The close out report is structured as per Catalyst guidelines and publicly available. It explains how the workshop educated attendees about CIP-1694, DReps, and Cardano's Voltaire-era governance.
・The report includes key achievements, highlights from interactive sessions, audience diversity, summary of discussions, and community insights on governance topics.
・It also captures key learnings, insights into the Indian Cardano community’s understanding of governance, and mentions that materials are open-sourced.
・While there are no immediate next steps planned, the team is open to future workshops based on interest.
・All relevant materials are publicly linked in the closeout report.
・The closeout video is also shared publicly.

Evidence of Milestone Completion
